scope: Root-cause and minimal fix for the BC6H image-view (USE_IMAGE_VIEW=1) zero-output defect found by the BC6H differential probe: with the pinned wrapper both BC6H_UFLOAT and BC6H_SFLOAT emulated R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT images stayed zero, while the bc6.comp staging path decoded bit-exactly. The fix binds the internal storage view as VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT (matching bc6.comp's rgba16ui output), bypasses the wrapper's own CreateImageView format-rewrite hook for that internal view, and includes the UINT view format in the emulated image's format list. Verified A/B on llvmpipe emulators: patched candidate decodes BC6H compute-view bit-exactly, pinned baseline still produces zero (negative control). Offscreen transfer-only probe; no app, phone/Adreno or CI result is claimed.

defect_reference.symptom: BC6H compute-view runs 0/4096 exact pixels, max ULP 31743/31744, zero-filled readback for candidate and baseline on 4 KB and 16 KB; staging path 4096/4096 exact.

hunks: wrapper_device.c: CmdComputeShaderForDecompression - for BC6H originals create the image-view storage view as VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT and create it through wrapper_device_trampolines.CreateImageView so the wrapper CreateImageView hook cannot rewrite it back to SFLOAT.

wrapper_image.c: emulated BC image creation - keep an explicit view-format list: when the app supplied VkImageFormatListCreateInfo, append R16G16B16A16_UINT for BC6H (viewFormatCount 2); when no list is supplied, synthesize one containing {emulated format, R16G16B16A16_UINT} so the MUTABLE_FORMAT image allows the internal UINT view.

root_cause.hypothesis_status: CONFIRMED with an additional wrapper self-patch layer (the numeric-type mismatch alone is necessary but not sufficient).
confirmed_evidence: bc6.comp line 68 declares `layout(set = 0, binding = 1, rgba16ui) uniform writeonly uimage2D dstImage`; the image-view output stores raw binary16 bit patterns via imageStore at bc6.comp lines 690 and 788.

wrapper_device.c CmdComputeShaderForDecompression (pristine lines ~1412-1440) created the storage view with `.format = unwrap_vk_format(_device, wimg->original_format)`, which is VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT (enum 97) for BC6H - a numeric type mismatch with the rgba16ui shader output; llvmpipe discards the writes, leaving the emulated image zero-filled.

Additional layer found with diagnostic logging: after changing the view format to VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT (enum 95), the wrapper's own WRAPPER_CreateImageView (wrapper_image.c ~179-186) rewrote it back to the emulated format. Logcat from the diagnostic build: `BC6H diagnostic: original=143 image=97 view=95` followed by `Patching ImageView format for tracked image from 95 to 97 (original img format: 143)`. The fix therefore bypasses WRAPPER_CreateImageView for this internal storage view via wrapper_device_trampolines.CreateImageView.

After the bypass the diagnostic run readback sha256 13541bd48e7e68c1... equals the bcdec reference sha256 exactly (32768 bytes, 20576 non-zero); the `Patching ImageView format ... 95 to 97` line no longer appears.

Format-list handling: wrapper_image.c (pristine lines ~62-101) replaced an app-supplied VkImageFormatListCreateInfo with a single emulated format; under VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT the UINT view must be an allowed view format. The patch appends R16G16B16A16_UINT (and synthesizes a list when the app supplied none; the probe supplies none, so this branch is exercised).
s3tc/bc7 shaders use rgba8/uimage outputs matched by R8G8B8A8_UNORM views, which is why only BC6H was affected; the BC7 image-view regression below stays bit-exact.

findings: The Lead's hypothesis is confirmed: the bc6.comp rgba16ui storage-image output was bound to a R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT view (numeric type mismatch), and llvmpipe dropped the writes.

A second, wrapper-internal cause was required: the wrapper's CreateImageView hook rewrote the internal UINT view back to SFLOAT; the fix must create that view through the raw trampoline (wrapper_device_trampolines.CreateImageView).

The emulated BC6H image is created with MUTABLE_FORMAT; the wrapper must allow R16G16B16A16_UINT in the image format list (append when supplied, synthesize when absent) for the storage view to be spec-valid.

Patched candidate BC6H compute-view is bit-exact (4096/4096, max ULP 0) for BC6H_UFLOAT and BC6H_SFLOAT on both 4 KB and 16 KB; the pinned baseline stays zero (negative control), and the bc6.comp staging path plus bc1/bc3/bc7 image-view paths are unchanged.
The fix deliberately keeps the shader writing raw binary16 bits via rgba16ui rather than switching to rgba16f, avoiding float NaN canonicalisation of BC6H endpoint bit patterns.
limitations: Software Vulkan only (llvmpipe inside the Android emulator); no phone/Adreno/KGSL or other physical GPU result is claimed.

No validation layer was loaded. The format-list legality of the UINT view under MUTABLE_FORMAT is reasoned from the Vulkan rules and exercised by llvmpipe, but no VUID validation run is part of this receipt.

The probe creates its BC images without VkImageFormatListCreateInfo, so the patched "append UINT to an app-supplied list" branch is not exercised by these runs; the "synthesize a list when none is supplied" branch is exercised (the probe path).

The staged build includes srgb-storage.patch and odd-extent.patch from staging-oddextent; the BC7 regression therefore uses --srgb-host-convention linear and the unpatched baseline host-cpu BC7_SRGB failure is expected, not a BC6H regression.

image-create.patch (repo) overlaps the wrapper_image.c emulated-image/format-list region; it was already present/reversed when tested on pristine 3abf4870, so the Lead should confirm the final stacked order. device-teardown/host-decode-map patches were not present yet; touched regions are named above.
The emulated image-view path is still marked experimental by the wrapper (USE_IMAGE_VIEW opt-in); this fix does not change that status.
